You don’t have a CoinWallet set up yet.

Install the app:

- [iPhone](https://a8ata.app.link/coinwallet_ios)
- [Android](https://a8ata.app.link/coinwallet_android)

Then:

1. Tap your avatar → **Add Wallet**.
2. Select **MPC Wallet**.
3. Keep the defaults → **Next**.
4. Enter a wallet name → **Confirm**.
5. Copy the 6-character invitation code and paste it here.
